Assignee and this claim are both written by the **PM seat**. ⛔ The dev inherits both, confirms the newest `Claim:` names its branch, posts **no** second `Claim:`, and ⛔ never writes the assignee or yields the card.

### Pre-dispatch checks this seat ran

| check | reading |
|:--|:--|
| open PRs touching any `tsconfig*` or `check-published-dist` | **0 of 15** — swept every open PR by files API |
| base at dispatch | `origin/main` = `c64975e9f44000ef5600a76e590606bfb64960ad` |

⇒ Dispatchable, no serial hazard.

### ⛔ Two rulings triage already made — carried as binding, ⛔ not re-litigated by the dev

1. **Direction:** point `tsBuildInfoFile` **outside the published output** (the gate's own remedy text recommends the package root). ⛔ **Do not** leave the record in `dist` and add a gate exemption — that is a permanent exception for a problem that can simply cease to exist.
2. **Scope:** unify `tsBuildInfoFile` across **all** composite packages, ⛔ **not** only the two that show today. Triage's reason, adopted verbatim: the others are hidden only because their `dist` already contains other `tsc` output — ⚠️ **coincidental masking, not protection**. Any package that switches `build` to `vite build` joins the two. This is 「make the correct form the only spelling」, ⛔ not scope creep.

⚠️ But ⛔ **do not turn this into a tsconfig refactor** to fix it 「at the right altitude」. If a shared base tsconfig exists, setting it there beats per-package lines; if not, one line per package is an acceptable landing — and either way note on the card that this belongs to objectui#7212's population. ⛔ Solving #7212 is not this card.

### The acceptance criterion is the card's own probe, run in order

`rm` the record → gate **green** → `tsc --noEmit` → gate **must still be green**. ⭐ That is the success test; "I moved the setting" does not pass it. Keep the control: `@object-ui/core` / `react` / `fields` carry no such record today and must not sprout anything after the fix. Confirm the record's new location **by re-running the gate**, ⛔ not by eyeballing the path.

## ACCEPT — PR objectui#9328, reviewed against the DIFF and the repo, ⛔ not against the report

`domain:devx` PM seat, session `session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`, round R56, 2026-09-13T00:47Z. Head `60a02a8787`, draft, **34 files +346/−3** — 30 `tsconfig.json`, 2 `package.json`, 1 pin test, 1 changeset.

### ⛔ FIRST — a premise I relayed as binding is WRONG, and the dev measured it

My claim comment carried triage's scope reasoning verbatim: *「the others are hidden only because their `dist` already holds other `tsc` output — coincidental masking, not protection」*.

**That mechanism is false.** Re-derived by this seat over every tracked `packages/*/tsconfig.json` on `0f3d15314d`:

| | count |
|:--|--:|
| `packages/*/tsconfig.json` | 40 |
| …`composite` or `incremental` | **30** |
| …of those, carrying `rootDir` | **12** |
| …of those, **without** `rootDir` — record derives into `outDir` | **18** |

All 18 have `outDir: "dist"`. ⇒ The discriminator is **`rootDir`**, ⛔ not the build tool, and ⛔ nothing was masking anything — the other 16 simply had not been type-checked in the tree the card measured. The dev proved it live: `tsc --noEmit` in `@object-ui/plugin-charts`, a package the card never names, reds the same gate.

⭐ **The ruling survives its own broken reason, and is strengthened.** `packages/components/tsconfig.json:10` says, in its own words:

```
// Removed rootDir to prevent file not under rootDir errors when importing from ..
```

⇒ That edit — made for an unrelated purpose — is exactly what moved its record into `dist`. The 12 「correct」 packages are **one unrelated edit away** from joining the 18. Unifying all 30 is therefore right for a better reason than the one I gave.

### Second premise measured false — and it closes off the option triage preferred

Triage said a shared base tsconfig would beat per-package lines *if one exists*. The dev injected the setting into the root `tsconfig.json` and re-derived: TypeScript resolves a **relative** `tsBuildInfoFile` against the config that **declares** it, so all 30 packages collapse onto a single repo-root record, each overwriting the others. ⇒ the per-package line is ⛔ not a shortcut here, it is the only spelling that works. objectui#7212 is noted, ⛔ not solved — as instructed.

### Acceptance, run in order — and the post-fix leg is stronger than the card asked

| step | before fix | after fix |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `rm` record → gate | EXIT 0 green | EXIT 0 green |
| `tsc --noEmit` | record recreated **in `dist`** | record lands at **package root** |
| gate again | **EXIT 1 RED — reproduced** | **EXIT 0 still green** |

⭐ The after-leg ran `turbo run type-check` across **all 81 tasks** before re-running the gate, not just the one package: records inside any `dist` afterwards = **0**, and tarball counts identical to the pre-fix green run (6013/5857) ⇒ nothing published moved.

⭐ **Controls verified here, independently** — this is what separates 「composite's fault」 from 「`type-check`'s fault」, so I re-read them rather than accepting them:
- `packages/fields/tsconfig.json` carries **no `composite`** at all ⇒ never had a record, and correctly still has none.
- `packages/core` and `packages/react` both carry `rootDir: "src"` ⇒ they are in the 12, their records were never in `dist`, and their paths are unchanged.

### ⭐ The two `clean` edits are NOT scope creep — and I checked the completeness rather than the count

With the record outside `dist`, a bare `rm -rf dist` deletes the outputs while leaving a record still claiming they exist — which reopens objectui#6703. Measured across every `packages/*/package.json` carrying a `clean` script:

| | |
|:--|--:|
| packages with a `clean` script | 10 |
| …**pinned** by this PR | 7 |
| …of those, already spelling `rm -rf dist tsconfig.tsbuildinfo` | **5** (`auth`, `collaboration`, `mobile`, `permissions`, `types`) |
| …of those, needing the edit | **2** (`data-objectstack`, `plugin-designer`) |
| …**edited by this PR** | **2** ✅ |
| not pinned, so correctly untouched | 3 (`fields`, `plugin-ai`, `plugin-report`) |

⇒ **No pinned package is left with a `clean` that misses its record, and no unpinned package was touched.** The set is exactly right, ⛔ not approximately right.

### The pin test

Accepted on its stated reasoning: *a spelling nothing enforces is not 「the only spelling」*. ⭐ It asks **TypeScript** where each record goes rather than grepping for the option — a presence-grep would pass on a value still pointing into `dist`. Ablated (removing the pin from `plugin-detail` reds it, naming the right path), restore verified by blob hash. And `type-check:scripts` was confirmed via `--listFiles` to actually **contain** the new test, ⛔ not merely to exit 0 — which is precisely the gap that sent PR objectui#9322 back this shift.

### ⛔ NOT armed

- CI on `60a02a8787` at this reading: **26 success · 3 skipped · 7 in_progress · 0 failing**. ⛔ Every check, not the required subset.
- `mergeable_state: **behind**` — `main` advanced to `0f3d15314d` mid-run. The base must be brought in by a **merge** before this can be flipped; ⛔ never a rebase on a pushed branch.

Filed out of the round and correctly not ridden in: **objectui#9329** (the gate's own remedy text recommends 「leave it at its default (the package root)」, which for a package with `outDir` reproduces this very defect) and **objectui#9330** (`tsconfig.base.json` is extended by no package).
